Column Selector

A column visibility and management panel with drag-to-reorder, column presets, pin/unpin, and resize reset functionality.

Column Selector Panel

Toggle the column selector dropdown to manage column visibility, reorder columns via drag handles, pin columns, and apply presets.

Features

  • Visibility Toggle — Show/hide columns with checkboxes.
  • Drag Reorder — Drag columns by handle to reorder.
  • Column Presets — All, Essential, Minimal presets for quick column layouts.
  • Pin/Unpin — Pin columns to the left side of the table.
  • Resize Reset — Reset all column widths to default.
  • Badge Counter — Shows number of visible columns.
